name: Postgres
summary: PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database. For agents it typically holds sessions, messages, checkpoints and app data in one transactional store that many workers can share, and extensions such as pgvector add vector search. It is offered as a managed service by Supabase, Neon, Amazon RDS and others.
goodFor: Combining sessions, app data and vectors in one store
watchOut: Needs a running server and connection management
Serverless and edge runtimes may need a pooler or HTTP driver
Large transcripts in rows can bloat tables; consider object storage for blobs
